spans.s:
जिहान जिहान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. हा, जिहीते),
going, going to, attaining, obtaining.
जिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, &c. See p. 347.

जिहानक, अस्, m. the destruction of the world;
[cf. जहानक.]

जिहासा जिहासा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. हा, ज-
हाति), desire of abandoning or giving up.

जिहासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of abandoning or
giving up.

जिहीर्षा जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ),
desire of seizing, taking, or robbing; wish to take
away or remove.

जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to seize, desirous of
taking or carrying or removing, wishing to rob or
appropriate.

जिहीर्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, desirable to be taken away
or brought near.

जिह्म जिह्म, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps related to
rt. ह्वृ; but said to be fr. rt. हा, जहाति, and to
denote originally quitting the upright direction or
leaning out of the perpendicular), sloping, oblique,
transverse, diagonal, athwart, squinting (as the eye),
crooked, awry, not straight (opposed to ऋजु),
tortuous, going irregularly; (जिह्मम् इ or गम्,
to go crookedly, turn off from the right way);
curved, bent; morally crooked, deceitful, deceptive,
illusory, false, untrue, unfair, dishonest; slow, lazy;
(अम्), n. falsehood, dishonesty; the plant Tabernæ-
montana Coronaria (तगर); [cf. Hib. giomh, ‘a
lock of hair, a fault.’]
—जिह्म-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going
tortuously or crookedly, moving slowly; (अस्), m. a
snake.
—जिह्म-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going tortuously.
—जिह्-
म-ता, f. or जिह्म-त्व, अम्, n. crookedness, curva-
ture; dishonesty, falsehood.
—जिह्म-बार, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. having an aperture on one side; (Sāy.) having
an opening below; having its door closed.
—जिह्म-
मीन, अस्, m. appearing in the deceptive shape of a
fish.
—जिह्म-मोहन, अस्, m. a frog.
—जिह्म-
योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting unfairly; (ई), m. epithet
of Bhīma, who in his great battle with Dur-yodhana
struck him an unfair blow with his club on the
thighs; (see Śalya-parva 3345.)
—जिह्म-शल्य,
अस्, m. the tree Acacia Catechu; [cf. खदिर.]
—जिह्म-शी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. lying crookedly or
[]
diagonally (on the ground &c.).
—जिह्माक्ष (˚म-
अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, crooked-eyed, squinting.
—जिह्-
माशिन् (˚म-आश्˚), ई, m. ‘eating crookedly,’ N. of a
man; (perhaps a wrong reading for जिह्वाशिन्.)

जिह्माय, nom. P., Ved. -यति, -यितुम्, to go
crookedly or in crooked ways.

जिह्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, bowed, curved; turned
away.

जिह्मी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make
crooked, bend.
—जिह्मी-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, making
crooked or oblique, causing to bend; (metaphori-
cally) obscuring.
—जिह्मी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made
crooked, bent, bowed down (with fear &c.).

जिह्व जिह्व, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. जि, per-
haps fr. rt. ह्वे; cf. 1. जुहू), the tongue; (आ), f. the
tongue; the tongue or tongues of Agni, i. e. various
forms of flame, (sometimes three are mentioned,
sometimes seven, the names of which are given as fol-
lows: काली, कराली, मनो-जवा, सु-लोहिता, सुधूम्र-
वर्णा, स्फुलिङ्गिनी, विश्व-रूपी; or are identified
with the seven winds, प्र-वह, आ-वह, उद्-वह,
सं-वह, वि-वह, परि-वह, and नि-वह. The
horses of Agni or वह्नयः are said to be सप्त-
जिह्वाः, having seven tongues); the root of the plant
Tabernæmontana Coronaria; [cf. जिह्म; cf. also Lat.
lingua ?; Goth. tuggô; Germ. Zunge; Hib. teanga ?].
—जिह्वा-कात्य, अस्, m., N. of a man, the voracious
Kātya.
—जिह्वाग्र (˚वा-अग्˚), अम्, n. the tip of the
tongue.
—जिह्वा-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the
tongue.
—जिह्वा-निर्लेखन and जिह्वा-निर्लेख-
निक, अम्, n. scraping the tongue; a tongue-scraper;
[cf. जिह्वोल्लेखन.]
—जिह्वा-प, अस्, m. (‘drinking
with the tongue’), a dog; a cat; a tiger; a panther,
the hunting leopard; a bear.
—जिह्वा-प्रथन,
अम्, n. expansion or too great flattening of the
tongue (a defect in pronunciation).
—जिह्वा-मल,
अम्, n. the fur of the tongue.
—जिह्वा-मूल, अम्,
n. the root of the tongue.
—जिह्वामूलीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
belonging to or uttered from the root of the tongue,
a term applied to the vowels ऋ, ऌ, the Visarga be-
fore क्, ख्, and the guttural class of consonants, but
especially to the Visarga before क्, ख्.
—जिह्वा-रद,
अस्, m. ‘having a tongue-like beak,’ a bird.
—जिह्वा-
लिह्, ट्, m. ‘licking with the tongue,’ a dog.
—जिह्वा-
लौल्य, अम्, n. greediness.
—जिह्वा-वत्, आन्, m., N.
of a preceptor.
—जिह्वा-शत, अम्, n. a hundred
tongues.
—जिह्वा-शल्य, अस्, m. = जिह्म-शल्य, q. v.
—जिह्वा-शोधन, अम्, n. cleaning of the tongue.
—जिह्वास्वाद (˚वा-आस्˚), अस्, m. ‘tasting with the
tongue,’ licking, lapping.
—जिह्वोल्लेखन (˚वा-
उल्˚), अम्, n. scraping the tongue; (ई and इका), f. a
tongue-scraper made of a thin piece of wood of the
Mimusops Kauki or other trees.

जिह्वक at the end of an adj. comp. in अ-जिह्-
वका, f. tongueless.
जिह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, voracious, greedy.

जिह्विका, f. a diminutive fr. जिह्वा; [cf. अधो-
जिह्विका, अलि-ज्˚, उप-ज्˚, प्रति-ज्˚.]
जिह्वु जिह्वु, उस्, m., N. of a man.
